Card Q&A.a:
You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such. At the end of the turn, you’ll lose memory as specified by each effect.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this Digimon in play. What happens if an effect is activated that causes you to gain memory on activation and lose memory at end of turn? (i.e. [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], [BT1-075 Digitamamon], etc.)

Card Q&A.a:
No, this Digimon prevents you from gaining memory from security effects.
                                            
                        Related Cards
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this Digimon in play. Can I gain memory from the security effect of [ST2-13 Hammer Spark]?

Effect: [All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects.
